s1.syndrome_frame: Malignant pleural disease with distant metastasis
salient_findings: Multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion on the left side
Nodular growth on the mid third of the tongue
Epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures
key_facts: 62-year-old nonsmoking man
Multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion on the left side
Underwent first-line chemotherapy followed by left pleurectomy
Residual microscopic disease after surgery
External beam radiotherapy administered
Disease remained stable until July 2023
Nodular growth appeared on the mid third of the tongue
Immunoreactive for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, Wilms tumor protein 1
Absence of nuclear staining for BRCA1-associated protein 1
Negative for methylthioadenosine phosphorylase
Homozygous deletion of CDKN2A gene by fluorescent in-situ hybridization

shortlist.label: Malignant pleural mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Immunoreactive for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, Wilms tumor protein 1, and homozygous deletion of CDKN2A gene

shortlist.label: Pleural sarcomatoid mesothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures and absence of nuclear staining for BRCA1-associated protein 1

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Neoplastic subepithelial proliferation and immunoreactive for calretinin

shortlist.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
shortlist.why_kept: Epithelioid cells and immunoreactive for calretinin

shortlist.label: Pseudomesotheliomatous adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Calretinin-positive and absence of nuclear staining for BRCA1-associated protein 1

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with multiple pleural thickenings and marked effusion, along with immunoreactivity for calretinin, AE1/AE3, D2-40, and Wilms tumor protein 1, and the absence of nuclear staining for BRCA1-associated protein 1, are consistent with malignant pleural mesothelioma. The homozygous deletion of the CDKN2A gene further supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pleural sarcomatoid mesothelioma
rejected.why: The presence of epithelioid solid formations with pseudopapillary structures and immunoreactivity for calretinin and other markers are more characteristic of epithelioid mesothelioma, not sarcomatoid mesothelioma.

rejected.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
rejected.why: The tumor cells are described as epithelioid, not small and round, and the immunohistochemical profile does not match that of desmoplastic small round cell tumor.

rejected.label: Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and immunohistochemical findings are not consistent with epithelioid hemangioendothelioma, which typically shows positivity for vascular markers such as CD31 and ERG.

rejected.label: Pseudomesotheliomatous adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: The absence of mucin production and the immunohistochemical profile, including negativity for mucin markers and positivity for mesothelial markers, argue against pseudomesotheliomatous adenocarcinoma.
